patthana22.21:1.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakka savicāro hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
patthana22.21:3.1: na pītisahagataṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca pītisahagato hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
patthana22.21:5.1: na dassanena pahātabbaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca bhāvanāya pahātabbo hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
patthana22.21:7.1: na dassanena pahātabba hetukaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca bhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko hetudhammo uppajjati hetu paccayā. hetuyā nava. na ācayagāmiṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ācayagāmi hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
patthana22.21:9.1: sekhaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca asekho hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
